From a rough idea to a prepared pitch.

  1. Know the room. Find event background and record the current organizer rules.
  2. Build your story. Edit six sections, attach source notes, and map requirements to slides.
  3. Prepare the moment. Assign speaking time, plan a demo fallback, and export your editable files.

An example, with the gaps visible.

ReLoop is a fictional campus food-surplus project used to demonstrate the workspace. Its untested claims stay marked for review. Open the workspace to inspect its story and preparation tools.

Free preview. No payment required.

The current workspace is free. Paid plans and checkout are not available. No charge is taken, so there is no purchase or refund transaction in this preview.

Projects stay in this browser. Export backups for durable storage or to move between websites. Drafts expire 24 hours after the last edit, checked when you reopen the app.

What this release can do.

Story editing, source notes, requirement mapping, speaking plans, feedback, editable PPTX, PDF for Latin text, ZIP kits, and selective text filling in a supported organizer PPTX.

AI generation, a simulated jury, comprehensive live event discovery, cloud team sharing, payments, and reviewed Hindi/Hinglish support are not connected. Organizer rules and exported layouts require your review.
